title: Noctiluca rollout gateway checklist and staffing snapshot (2027-01) - draft
content:
Context

Purpose: capture a compact, operational-first checklist and hour-by-hour staffing snapshot for the Noctiluca gateway rollout (feature gates, model-routing changes, and new KV-cache behavior). This is a working draft — aim is to run a dry-run on Dec 3 and a live rollout during the quiet window on Jan 14 UTC.

High-level objectives
- Roll new gateway routing with zero-regression to 99th percentile latency and error budget consumption.
- Validate prefix KV-cache warmup across regional nodes.
- Verify automatic fallback to legacy model-bundle when capacity constraints hit.

Quick summary timeline (UTC)
- D-7 (2027-01-07): Final smoke test in staging, deadman-tilt list review.
- D-3 (2027-01-11): Team dry-run + telemetry deck.
- D-1 (2027-01-13): Feature gate freeze at 09:00; last-minute rollbacks allowed until 18:00.
- D0 (2027-01-14) Quiet window 00:00-06:00: Progressive traffic shift 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m hold at each stage.
- D+1 (2027-01-15): Post-rollout stabilization checks and incident watch.

Staffing snapshot (who is on-call / who runs what)
- Lead conductor: Riley Chen (release-engineering) — overall rollout lead, final go/no-go. Contact: #release-orchestra on Slack and +1 phone.
- Traffic shepherd: Samira Gupta (serving-runtime) — executes traffic-weight shifts, monitors slowdowns.
- Telemetry & metrics: Ethan Morris (observability) — dashboard owner, thresholds pre-configured.
- Fallback & ops: Leah Park (sre) — runs automated fallback and rollback if thresholds breach.
- Escalation: Priya Iyer (eng-leads) — executive escalation contact.
- Overnight on-call coverage: region A on-call (UTC nights): Ankit Rao; region B: Mei Lin.

Preflight checklist (complete by D-3)
- [ ] Staging smoke results posted (link CONFLUENCE-1234).
- [ ] All PRs merged and CI green; no >2 day PRs pending. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/noctiluca/pull/412
- [ ] Canary image tagged with semantic version and manifest uploaded to registry.
- [ ] Canary config stored in config-store and validated (checksum match).
- [ ] Runbook distributed to on-call and SRE rotation.
- [ ] Telemetry thresholds defined and tested (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, token-rate, model-queue-depth).
- [ ] DB-migrations checked and reversible; migrations run in staging and observed for 48h.

D0 rollout checklist (order matters)
- Stage 0 — smoke warmup (T0): verify baseline metrics from last 24h. Confirm watchlist ready.
- Stage 1 — 0%-1% (T0 + 5m): push routing change to a small fraction of traffic. Hold 10m. Actions: traffic shepherd executes shift command, telemetry validates no spike.
  - Commands: gh workflow run rollout-shift --env=prod --to=1
  - Watch metrics: 5xx rate <= baseline + 0.05%, p99 latency delta <= 15ms, cache-hit-rate increase <= expected.
- Stage 2 — 5% (T0 + 25m): if no alerts, push to 5%. Hold 10m. Confirm KV-cache warms across nodes (cache warmth > 40%).
- Stage 3 — 20% (T0 + 45m): hold 10m. Run sample QA prompts via canary agent.
- Stage 4 — 60% (T0 + 65m): hold 10m. Check model-queue-depth and token throughput.
- Stage 5 — 100% (T0 + 85m): full cutover. Maintain watch for 4h.

Abort / rollback quick plan (if ANY blocking threshold triggered)
- Immediate rollback steps (fast):
  - Traffic shepherd: run rollback command to restore legacy routing (target 100% legacy)
    - Command: gh workflow run rollback-shift --env=prod --to=100
  - SRE: cut the gateway feature flag to OFF via feature-store console.
  - Observability: annotate the incident in dashboards and trigger on-call paging.
- Post-rollback: collect dump from gateway nodes (logs + kv-cache state), open JIRA RN-xxxx and tag with rollback notes.

Telemetry gating thresholds (breach if ANY true during hold)
- Global 5xx rate > 0.1% over baseline for two consecutive holds.
- p99 latency increase > 3x baseline or absolute increase > 200ms for 3m window.
- Token-processing-rate drop > 20% sustained for hold window.
- Cache warmup < 25% after stage 2 for more than 15m.

Operator quick commands (copyable)
- shift to percentage: gh run shift --percent 5 --manifest canary-2027-01-14
- force rollback: gh run rollback --manifest canary-2027-01-14
- get node logs (region-a): kubectl logs -l app=noctiluca -n prod --tail=500
- snapshot kv-cache stats: curl -s http://gateway-metrics/kvstats | jq . > kvstats.json

Observation & testing during holds
- Traffic-shepherd runs 10 synthetic probe prompts to verify response shape and token counts. Keep samples in /testing/canary/samples.txt.
- Observability runs: short-lived flamegraphs on increased CPU nodes, tokenization errors sampling.
- SRE runs connectivity sweep for any increased connection churn; escalate if thread-pool saturation observed.

Notes for release notes draft (short bullets to copy into customer-facing RN)
- Introduced Noctiluca gateway routing improvements that reduce tail latency by optimizing KV-cache warm paths.
- Enabled staged fallback to legacy model-bundle to maintain request continuity under capacity pressure.
- Minor behavior change: a small increase in initial cache-warmup delay for cold nodes; expected to improve with warmup tuning.
- Impact: no expected API surface change; performance improvement targeted for high-concurrency workloads.

Post-rollout checks (D0 + 4h, D+1)
- D0 + 4h: confirm 24h rolling window metrics trending stable; update release notes with final metrics.
- D+1: run the synthetic suite overnight and post regression summary to #release-orchestra.
- D+3: summarize CANARY->PROD observations and open follow-ups for optimization tasks.

Open questions / TODOs
- Do we need to temporarily increase token-cache retention for region-C to accelerate warmup? (action: Ethan)
- Verify rate-limiter integration with new routing path (action: Samira).
- Confirm legal/compliance review for telemetry retention change (action: Leah).

Dry-run checklist (run as simulation D-3)
- [ ] Run full staged shift in staging environment with scaled-down traffic generator.
- [ ] Verify all quick commands work with no permission errors.
- [ ] Validate that rollback completed within 2m in simulation.
- [ ] Post dry-run notes to CONFLUENCE-1234 and update this doc.

Appendix: slack & pager channels
- Primary ops channel: #release-orchestra
- Telemetry & alerts: #telemetry-alerts
- Pager escalation: oncall@sre.redwood.com (pager duty)

End notes
This is intentionally concise and procedural. Keep edits to bullet points only; if you want to add design rationale, create the linked CONFLUENCE-1234. For now this file is the operational checklist we hand to the conductor the morning of the rollout.
